mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real estate sales (HOUST) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances when HOUST shows a sustained 3-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a quarter signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a quarter signals strengthening supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) within a quarter indicates a shift in consumer spending from goods to services, which alters the composition of corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases & RSAFS decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1% signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within a quarter signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% within a quarter.
